newsitem.title: UK: Cordiant buys out Saatchi French operation.
newsitem.headline: Cordiant buys out Saatchi French operation.

text.p: Cordiant Plc, the advertising group, said on Wednesday it had bought an outstanding 47 percent minority interest in the French operation of Saatchi & Saatchi Advertising Worldwide.
Cordiant said in a statement it had agreed the cash buy of 171 million French francs (21 million stg) from current and former employees and directors of the group.
It said the transaction had been completed today.
